title: Simple and easy to use, but the App Store listing is misleading
text:
Find Air is a clean, straightforward device-tracker app that is easy to set up and understand. I can see the value it could provide in a one-off situation… especially when you simply need to identify whether a nearby Bluetooth device is present.

That said, the App Store screenshots create expectations the app does not currently meet. The images imply a map-based experience and more robust item-finding capabilities, but there is no actual map or navigation feature in the app. There is also no directional guidance comparable to Apple’s Find My experience, such as helping you walk toward a device with distance or directional prompts.
The app is also limited when the item’s Bluetooth Low Energy signal is unavailable because the device is asleep or BLE is disabled. In those situations, there does not appear to be a way to locate the device at all.

There is potential here, and the core experience is simple and approachable. However, the developer should either update the App Store images to more accurately reflect the current functionality or add the map, directional finding, and offline/sleep-state capabilities that users may reasonably expect from the listing.
